liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): Bobby's vocal effect on The Other One is described as creepy; The Other One is described as intensely brain-melting, among the band's most intense playing [9][11][15]
- **Stella Blue** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this their favorite Stella Blue ever, sadness turning into triumph with towering power; The drop from The Other One into Stella Blue is wonderful, with strong emotion and evident fun [8][11][15]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Bird Song musters some might and is described as an intricate version; Reviewer calls the Bird Song awesome [12][17]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Rooster is convincingly bluesy but drags, according to the reviewer [12]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Jerry's hyperspace, sci-fi style playing lifts Music above average [12]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Spacey effects during Uncle John's Band are singled out as a second-set highlight [9]
- **Drums** (1 review): Chanting heard during Drums is praised by the reviewer [9]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Throwing Stones is singled out as definitely noteworthy [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-03-18.sbd.miller.91157.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-03-18.sbd.willy.7989.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 139 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd88-03-18.sbd.samaritano.21298.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 143 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the sound quality of this soundboard five stars, and says the playing holds up well; Reviewer finds the recording excellent, with a small adjustment in Iko Iko that is tolerable; Reviewer calls the sound very good, especially amazing on The Other One [10][14][16]
- **gd1988-03-18.141953.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min [2]

## Around the show

- Encore was Brokedown Palace, following Not Fade Away [2]
- Reviewer says the first set has a bad song order, while the show from The Other One on is great [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-03-18.sbd.miller.91157.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (48k) D [1]
- **gd1988-03-18.sbd.willy.7989.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Willly; source: SBD>DAT>CD [5]. Also: Willy removed a minor dropout in the tuning between Ship of Fools and Uncle John's Band using CE2K [5]
- **gd88-03-18.sbd.samaritano.21298.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard->DAT Master->DAT. DAT->ZA2->.wav->mkw->SHN. Transfer and SHN by Joe Samaritano [6]
- **gd1988-03-18.141953.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1988-03-18 Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center, Oakland, CA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/08/grateful-dead-1988-03-18-henry-j-kaiser.html) [20]
